name: Bartlomiej Pathak
role: Black market dealer and aug shop owner (unlicensed low-tier augmentation parts)
location: The Oxidian Market, Ironvein, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Bartlomiej Pathak is short and sharp-featured, with warm dark brown skin, natural hair cut close on the sides and loose on top, and a right arm from the elbow down that is a mismatched patchwork of three different manufacturers' chrome â€” she's repaired it so many times with whatever parts were available that it has become a kind of portfolio piece, demonstrating exactly what she can do with limited materials. She has cat ears (geneware, a gift from her older sister at fifteen, mottled gray-black) that she keeps unselfconsciously expressive. Her stall is in the Oxidian Market's lower row, technically licensed as a 'personal electronics repair' operation, which is true as far as it goes.

Bartlomiej Pathak moves fast and thinks faster â€” she has the focused intensity of someone who taught herself cyberware installation from pirated Helix Biosystems technical manuals and has so far not killed anyone, which she considers evidence that she knows what she's doing. She does, mostly. She is the go-to for people in the Ironvein-adjacent neighborhoods who need basic augmentation work â€” neural ports, subdermal mods, sensory enhancements â€” but can't access licensed clinics due to cost, ID status, or warrant concerns. She is not reckless but she operates in a space with no margin for error and she knows it. She has a quick, fierce loyalty to regulars and a zero-tolerance policy for anyone who tries to use her clientele as a pressure point.

core_fears: Killing someone on the table through a mistake she should have caught
Being shut down by a corponation licensing enforcement sweep â€” not for herself, but because her clients will have nowhere to go
core_desires: To get good enough that she can fix anything, eventually including herself
A legitimate clinic â€” her own, licensed, affordable, real
coping_mechanisms: Hyper-focus on technical problems as a way to not feel the weight of what she's carrying
Physicality â€” she runs in the Ironvein drainage tunnels at 2am when she can't sleep
blind_spots: Her protective instinct for clients sometimes overrides her self-preservation calculus in ways that are genuinely dangerous
She reads aggression as a challenge to solve rather than a signal to leave
psychology.secret: She botched an installation fourteen months ago â€” a neural port that she installed slightly misaligned, causing the client chronic low-grade pain they haven't connected to her work yet. She thinks about it every day. She hasn't told them.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical cyberware terminology delivered at speed, Guinean-French constructions from her parents' household, Ironvein street slang, impatient clipping of non-essential words
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, staccato, always sounds like she's already thinking about the next thing
verbal_tics: Clicks the fingers of her cybernetic hand when thinking â€” a distinctive soft metallic tap
'Yeah, I can do that.' (said before fully hearing the request, then amended)
example_lines: 'Neural port, basic, one-hour install, Î¦55 parts and labor, you're in and out. Helix charges Î¦200 and makes you sign four data agreements. You tell me.'
'Don't touch anything in the back room. Not because I'm precious about it. Because some of it is live.'

story_hooks: The client with the misaligned neural port has started developing symptoms she recognizes, and she has to decide whether to come forward before they connect the dots themselves â€” or before it gets worse

A Helix Biosystems licensing enforcement team has started moving through the Oxidian Market, and someone is tipping them toward specific stalls â€” Amara needs to know if she's on the list and who is feeding information
narrative_function: Low-cost augmentation source, contact for unlicensed installation, connection to ID-adjacent and warrant-flagged populations, quest giver for supply and equipment problems
augmentations: Right arm (elbow-down) â€” multi-manufacturer patchwork cyberlimb, high-dexterity fine motor configuration; gray-black mottled cat ears (geneware, cosmetic); reinforced sternum plate (installed herself, precautionary)
daily_life: She opens at 10am, does consultations and sales until 3pm, then does installation and repair work in the back room until midnight. She eats one large meal a day, always from the same dumpling cart, always at 6pm.
affiliation: Independent; pays informal dues to the Oxidian Market Vendors Guild and has a protective arrangement with a local crew called the Ironvein Laterals

decision_rules: Never install something she hasn't verified is clean and functional â€” her reputation and someone's body depend on it equally
Never give up a client's identity or medical information regardless of who asks
escalation_ladder: Firm verbal no and return to work
Stands up and addresses it directly with the Laterals visibly nearby
Calls the Laterals in explicitly â€” she doesn't fight if she doesn't have to

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Brisk and professional â€” assesses competence and threat level simultaneously, warms up fast if neither is a problem
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loud, teasing, genuinely invested, will work unpaid on their hardware at 1am if they need it

stress_responses.medium: Stops talking entirely and focuses exclusively on whatever is in her hands
stress_responses.high: Runs. Literally. Gets to the drainage tunnels and runs until she can think again.

contradictions: Deeply risk-averse about her clients' bodies; cavalier about her own safety
habits: Taps a rhythm on the workbench with her cybernetic fingers between tasks
Reads pirated technical manuals on her tablet every night before sleep
Always shakes hands with the cybernetic arm â€” she says it lets her assess someone's grip response
breaking_points: Harm coming to a client due to her work
Someone threatening to report her clientele to corponation enforcement

timeline.event: Born in Ironvein to Guinean-MÄori parents; father a pipeworks laborer, mother a market vendor
Sister gave her the cat ears geneware mod for her 12th birthday; first exposure to cosmetic modification
Lost two fingers to a factory press at 15; received a basic public-tier cybernetic replacement; became obsessed with how it worked
Taught herself installation from pirated Helix manuals; performed her first successful unlicensed install on herself
Opened the stall; misaligned neural port incident occurred fourteen months before current date
Current: established Oxidian Market presence, guilt ongoing, Helix enforcement sweep beginning

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly South Asian (54.4%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (31.2%), Middle Eastern (8.3%), Northern European (4.0%), and Central Asian (2.1%) ancestry. Her phenotype reflects this dominant South Asian foundation with warm undertones from Latin American and Middle Eastern heritage, creating a striking multicultural appearance. The South Asian structure forms her base â€” high cheekbones, defined jawline â€” while Hispanic/Latin American warmth and Middle Eastern richness layer into her complexion and facial structure.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, all lean muscle with minimal body fat â€” the physique of someone who moves constantly and eats efficiently. Narrow shoulders, sharp hip bones, the kind of frame that fits easily into tight workspaces.
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut: sides clipped to 3mm, top left long and textured, often pulled back with strips of salvaged synthetic material or left loose to frame her face
physical_description.hair_length: Short on sides, medium-long on top
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm golden-brown with olive and terracotta undertones, reflecting the South Asian depth as primary tone enhanced by Hispanic/Latin American warmth and Middle Eastern richness. Luminous and even complexion with subtle warmth throughout.
physical_description.complexion: High cheekbones with defined angularity characteristic of South Asian heritage, balanced by a warm, gently rounded jawline influenced by Hispanic/Latin American and Middle Eastern structure. Small, slightly rounded nose with warm undertones. Eyes set with the subtle depth typical of South Asian phenotype. Skin is clear with minor reactive irritation around the right shoulder joint â€” faint chemical burns from solder work.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scar across the underside of right forearm (chrome side), approximately 4cm long, from an early installation mistake at age 18
Thin burn marks on inner left wrist from acid chemical contact during parts cleaning, three parallel lines, each 1-2cm
Surgical scar at right elbow where the patchwork prosthetic attaches, reinforced with subdermal titanium mesh
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm from elbow down is a obvious mismatched cybernetic limb: three distinct chrome sections in slightly different finish (brushed matte, polished reflective, and worn gunmetal gray), assembled and reassembled with visible seam work and cross-manufacturer connectors. The palm and fingers show evidence of constant micro-welding and replacement. Mottled gray-black cat ears (geneware) protrude from the top of her skull, naturally expressive â€” rotate and twitch with her emotional state and attention. A faint outline of reinforced sternum plating is visible under fitted clothing as a subtle geometric pattern beneath the skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves economically and fast, with the precise coordination of someone who works constantly with her hands. Her right arm moves with the fluid but noticeably different rhythm of installed chrome â€” slightly faster, smoother, zero hesitation. She often holds objects or tools in her chrome hand while working with her left. Cat ears track conversations and movement around her workspace; they point toward whoever is speaking to her. She rarely sits still; even while talking, her fingers are working â€” stripping wire, sorting components, tightening fasteners. Her gaze is direct and unsentimental.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 / Ironvein working-class practical: form-fitting dark synthetic bodysuit (midnight blue or black, water-resistant), reinforced at elbows and knees with gray neoprene panels. Oversized sleeveless utility vest in charcoal with deep pockets and magnetic panel-strips for holding small tools and components. Heavy-duty work boots with steel toe and grippy soles (scuffed, well-maintained). Fingerless gloves on her left hand only; her right chrome hand is always bare. A thin chain collar of brushed steel around her neck, no pendant. Her fingers are stained with trace amounts of solder and component residue that never fully wash out. She wears no jewelry beyond the collar and occasionally salvaged circuit-board rings on her left hand (functional and cosmetic).
